question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The mother told the child to __erase__ the extra dots from the given graph.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Create)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"erase"** means to remove or delete something completely, especially by rubbing, wiping, or other similar methods. (मिटाना)

 
 
• **Example: **She used an eraser to erase the pencil marks on the paper.
 
 
 
• **"Create" **means to bring something into existence or to generate something new. It is the antonym of "erase" as creating is the act of making while erasing is the act of removing. (बनाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The artist worked tirelessly to create a masterpiece.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'erase' **is **'create'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Create)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shatter **(टुकड़े-टुकड़े करना): To break or cause to break suddenly into pieces.

 
 
• **Example:** The vase fell and shattered into tiny fragments on the floor.
 
 
 
• **Delete **(हटाना): To remove or obliterate something, especially written or digital content.
 
 
• **Example: **Make sure to delete unnecessary files from your computer.
 
 
 
• **Efface** (मिटाना): To erase or remove something from a surface or memory.
 
 
• **Example:** Over time, the words carved into the stone were effaced by weathering.
